Game will restart in a few of seconds...

[color=#eb5c35]--- Objective ---[/color]
Secure 5 samples of each friendly life form on this planet. Use your hook to collect them.

[color=#eb5c35]--- Controls ---[/color]
[color=#b09ffd]\[A]\[D][/color]: Move          [color=#b09ffd]\[Space][/color]: Double jump          [color=#b09ffd]\[Mouse][/color]: Aim          [color=#b09ffd]\[Click][/color]: Deploy hook

[color=#eb5c35]--- Note ---[/color]
Expect evasive behavior. Some species conceal themselves, while others occupy high ground. Use your hook to latch onto gears ([icon=gear]) to reach otherwise inaccessible positions.

[color=#eb5c35]--- Warning ---[/color]
Initial scans confirm hostile entities in the area, such as:
[size=32][icon=e3][icon=e1][icon=e4][icon=e2][icon=e5][/size]
Do not engage, as direct contact is fatal!

Monitor your oxygen levels. Support pods ( [icon=oxygen] ) have been deployed. Make contact to replenish your supply and maintain operational range.

Press [color=#b09ffd]\[Space][/color] to start...
